source_caption_text:
His potential was off the charts manyn

Pop Smoke’s verse on “GATTI” is one of the moments that made JACKBOYS feel so memorable. The song gave him a chance to bring his Brooklyn drill sound into Travis Scott’s world, and his deep voice immediately changes the energy when he comes in. From the opening line, Pop sounds completely locked in.

Produced by 808Melo, the beat gives Pop plenty of room to work with the sliding 808s and dark atmosphere. His delivery is simple but full of presence, with the “Woo” ad-libs and that unmistakable voice doing most of the heavy lifting. He didn’t need to overcomplicate the verse to make it stand out.

“GATTI” also became an important moment in Pop Smoke’s career because it put him alongside Travis on a major release just months before his passing. Looking back at the song now, the verse captures Pop right as his profile was starting to reach a much bigger audience, making it an especially memorable part of JACKBOYS.
